title: New in Symfony 8.2: Custom Property Accessors
content:
<html><head></head><body>The PropertyInfo component tells the rest of Symfony how to read and write the
properties of your objects. It finds the methods by convention: getName(),
isActive(), setName(), addRole(), removeRole(), etc. That works
for most classes, but not for the ones…</body></html>
